en.title: Robot Bus | Messaging for connected robots
en.description: A lightweight messaging framework for robot applications. Use ROS 2–style topics, services, and actions across six SDKs, with ZeroMQ and an optional ROS 2 bridge.
en.model_description: Build around a familiar Node API and choose the right messaging pattern for each part of your system.
en.topic_description: Stream sensor readings, state updates, and other data to any number of subscribers.
en.service_description: Request a discrete operation and receive a typed response, such as toggling a device.
en.action_description: Send a goal for long-running work, monitor progress, and retrieve a result or cancel the goal.
en.architecture_description: Native nodes exchange messages over ZeroMQ. Browser apps use WebSocket, and operators open the console on the shared HTTP listener.
en.architecture_alt: Native nodes use ZeroMQ, browser apps use the WebSocket gateway, and operators use the HTTP console. These endpoints share one broker, which routes Protobuf topics, services, and actions.
en.start_description: A Rust controller, Python tooling, or a TypeScript browser app can all connect to the same broker. Start with a package and follow its SDK guide.
en.console_description: The broker serves its own console. Open it in a browser to inspect traffic and see how nodes connect.
en.console_graph_description: Browse topics, services, actions, and their connections.
en.console_demo_description: Drive with the keyboard or send a goal from the map.
en.console_alt: Robot Bus web console showing an online broker and traffic on /examples/imu.
en.console_recording: Start the broker with Python and open the console
en.deployment_description: Run an embedded broker or connect across hosts.
en.bridge_description: Connect to a Humble or Jazzy graph through an optional in-process bridge.
en.web_lab_description: Follow a browser client through a Python bridge to a ROS 2 peer.
en.performance_description: Explore queue behavior and benchmark methodology.
en.support_description: Check supported platforms and verified capabilities.

zh.title: Robot Bus | 机器人系统消息通信框架
zh.description: 面向机器人应用的轻量级消息框架。基于 ZeroMQ，提供六种 SDK、ROS 2 风格的话题、服务和动作，以及可选的 ROS 2 桥接。
zh.model_description: 基于统一的 Node API，按场景选择发布订阅、请求响应，或带反馈的异步任务。
zh.topic_description: 将传感器读数、状态更新等持续数据分发给多个订阅方。
zh.service_description: 发起一次明确的操作并接收类型化响应，例如切换设备开关。
zh.action_description: 为长时间运行的任务发送目标、接收进度反馈，并获取结果或取消目标。
zh.architecture_description: 原生节点走 ZeroMQ，网页应用走 WebSocket，运维人员通过 Broker 的共享 HTTP 端口打开控制台。
zh.architecture_alt: 原生节点走 ZeroMQ，网页应用使用 WebSocket 网关，运维人员通过 HTTP 打开控制台。同一个 Broker 转发使用 Protobuf 的话题、服务和 Action。
zh.start_description: Rust 控制器、Python 工具和 TypeScript 浏览器应用可以连接同一个 Broker。安装 SDK 后，按对应指南接入。
zh.start_link: 运行 Python 快速开始示例
zh.console_description: Broker 自带 Web 控制台。用浏览器即可查看消息活动、连接关系和节点状态。
zh.console_graph_description: 浏览话题、服务、动作及其连接。
zh.console_demo_description: 用键盘操控，或在地图上点击发送目标。
zh.console_alt: Robot Bus Web 控制台，显示 Broker 在线及 /examples/imu 话题的活动。
zh.console_recording: 从 Python 启动 Broker 到打开控制台
zh.deployment_description: 运行嵌入式 Broker，或建立跨主机连接。
zh.bridge_description: 通过可选的进程内桥接接入 Humble 或 Jazzy。
zh.web_lab_description: 运行从浏览器经 Python 桥接到真实 ROS 2 节点的示例。
zh.performance_description: 了解队列行为和基准测试方法。
zh.support_description: 查看支持的平台和已验证的功能。
